findings.source_evidence: Theorem 2.1.3 has right-hand side rho/sqrt(N) with coefficient exactly 1.
findings.lean_evidence: The target uses prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant*rho/sqrt(N), and that constant is greater than 1.
findings.impact: The target proves only a strictly looser estimate and does not imply the selected source statement.

rationale: The probability setting, i.i.d. hypotheses, mean, variance, normalized centered sum, upper-tail event, standard-normal law, moment ratio, sample-size domain, and quantifier structure match. The decisive mismatch is the additional coefficient D003 > 1. Thus the source implies the Lean estimate on Lean's explicit effective domain, but the Lean estimate does not recover coefficient one.
